term: Church: visible society and spiritual community
resolution: The stage-5 proposition uses DEF-CHURCH-VISIBLE-AUTHORITATIVE-SOCIETY for its visibility, continuance and authority condition. Lumen gentium §8 simultaneously names DEF-CHURCH-SPIRITUAL-COMMUNITY and rejects their separation into two realities. This reading neither replaces the visible condition with invisible communion alone nor reduces the Church to an external organization. It asserts no identity with a particular modern society and does not settle the separate historical-identity claim in stage 6.
